items.headline: Ethiopia ne Sudan ke 6 rajnayik nikale
items.detail: Ethiopia ne Sudan ke Assosa vanijya dutawas ke chhah karmiyon ko 48 ghante me desh chhodne ko kaha; dono desh ek-doosre par sashastr guton ko samarthan dene ka aarop lagate hain.
items.exam_angle: Horn of Africa aur kootneeti: International exams ke liye — Sudan grih yuddh aur kshetriya tanaav.

items.headline: Ronaldo ne international football se sannyas liya
items.detail: Portugal ke 41 saal ke star ne video message me kaha, woh November break ke baad No. 7 shirt wapas karenge; 234 match me 146 goal ka record banaya.
items.exam_angle: Khel GK: Purush international football me sabse zyada goal (146) aur match (234) ka record.

items.headline: Riyadh airport hamle me marne wale 14 hue
items.detail: Bharatiya dutawas ne kaha 10 October ke hamle me gambhir ghayal doosre Bharatiya nagrik ki ICU me maut ho gayi; kul mrityu sankhya 14 ho gayi.
items.exam_angle: Houthi-Saudi sangharsh aur Khadi suraksha: West Asia ke liye exam angle.

items.headline: Qatar ke paas tanker par do projectile hamle
items.detail: UKMTO ne kaha Madinat ash Shamal se 50 nautical mile door tanker par do agyaat projectile lage; crew ki haalat aur nuksan abhi pata nahi.
items.exam_angle: Khadi me samudri suraksha aur tel marg: International exams ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Uttar Korea: Nayi missile ka parikshan, drill bhi
items.detail: Uttar Korea ne Budhvar ko nayi air defence missile ka parikshan kiya aur lambi doori ki cruise missile se ek nakli hawai adde par hamle ki drill bhi ki; Dakshin Korea ki sena ne Sondok se samudra ki taraf kai missile chhode jaane ki pushti ki hai.
items.exam_angle: Uttar Korea aur missile parikshan: International exams ke liye — suraksha parishad pratibandh aur kshetriya tanaav.

items.headline: Schumer: Democrat Iran yuddh khatm karenge
items.detail: Senate ke Democrat neta Chuck Schumer ne kaha unki party Iran yuddh khatm karegi aur Congress ke kharch par niyantran ka istemal karke Trump par dabav banayegi; kuch Republican bhi is prayas me saath hain.
items.exam_angle: America ki yuddh shaktiyan: International exams ke liye — Congress ka 'power of the purse' aur yuddh ghoshna.

items.headline: WHO: Ebola ki do nayi vaccine ka trial
items.detail: WHO ne Congo me Bundibugyo Ebola ke khilaf Oxford-Serum Institute aur Moderna ki do nayi vaccine ke clinical trial ko manzoori di; is prakop me 5,300 se zyada logon ki maut ho chuki hai.
items.exam_angle: Ebola aur vaccine trial: International exams ke liye — WHO, Bundibugyo strain aur swasthya sankat.

items.headline: Israel: Chunav nateeje pramanit, sarkar par baatchit
items.detail: Israel ke chunav aayog ne dhokhadhadi ka koi saboot na milne par 27 October ke chunav nateeje pramanit kar diye; Rashtrapati Herzog ne sarkar banane ke liye dalon se baatchit shuru ki — Netanyahu ke gathbandhan ko 53 aur Eisenkot ke vipaksh ko 48 seatein mili hain.
items.exam_angle: Israel ki sansadiya vyavastha: International exams ke liye — chunav, gathbandhan aur rashtrapati ki bhoomika.

items.headline: Bottoms: America ki pehli Black mahila governor
items.detail: Democrat Keisha Lance Bottoms ne Georgia me Republican Rick Jackson ko harakar America ki pehli Black mahila governor banne ka itihaas racha; ve 1998 ke baad Georgia ki pehli Democrat governor bhi hain.
items.exam_angle: America ki chunav vyavastha: International exams ke liye — pehli Black mahila governor aur Georgia chunav.

items.headline: France: Desh bhar hadtaal, 70,000 police tainat
items.detail: France me mazdoor sanghon ki desh-vyapi hadtaal aur pradarshan aaj hue; sarkar ne 70,000 police tainat kiye aur 5–7 lakh logon ke sadkon par utarne ka anumaan hai.
items.exam_angle: France aur mazdoor andolan: International exams ke liye — hadtaal, jeevan-yapan aur sarkar.

items.headline: France: Blood bank par cyber hamla
items.detail: France ke teen kshetriya blood bank me cyber hamle se khoon rakhne wale fridge ki nigrani vyavastha prabhavit hui; adhikariyon ne kaha khoon ki aapurti par koi asar nahi pada.
items.exam_angle: Cyber suraksha aur swasthya seva: International exams ke liye — mahatvapurna buniyadi dhanche par hamla.

items.headline: Hormuz me do tanker, tugboat me aag
items.detail: IRGC ne kaha do tel tanker aur ek tugboat Hormuz Strait me aag ki chapet me aaye; ek tanker 'gair-kanuni' raste par mine se takraya, jabki doosra supertanker aag me ghir gaya.
items.exam_angle: Hormuz Strait aur tel marg: International exams ke liye — samudri suraksha aur vishwa tel vyapaar.

items.headline: Armenia: Vipaksh ne ekjut hone ka elaan kiya
items.detail: Armenia ke vipakshi dalon ne 'rashtriya ekjutata' banane ka elaan kiya; naya samvidhan kharij karna aur bina ektarfa samjhote ke shanti unki prathamikta hai.
items.exam_angle: Armenia aur Dakshin Caucasus: International exams ke liye — samvidhan, shanti aur vipaksh.

items.headline: Japan: Docomo network desh bhar thapp
items.detail: NTT Docomo ne kaha subah 11:18 baje se pure Japan me call, data aur SMS mushkil ho gaye; isse pehle online shop aur My docomo bhi band kiye gaye kyunki server me ghuspaith ka shak hai.
items.exam_angle: Japan ki telecom suraksha: International exams ke liye — cyber hamla aur aavashyak seva par asar.

items.headline: Nithya Raman LA ki pehli Asian-American mayor
items.detail: Kerala me janmi Nithya Raman ne Los Angeles mayoral chunav me incumbent Karen Bass ko 51.67% vote se haraya; ve shahar ki pehli Asian-American mayor banengi.
items.exam_angle: America ki chunav vyavastha: International exams ke liye — Bharatiya mool ki pehli LA mayor.

items.headline: Hong Kong: Joshua Wong ko 10 saal aur
items.detail: Hong Kong High Court ne Joshua Wong ko videshi taaqaton se milne ke aarop me 10 saal ki saza sunayi; ve January me riha hone wale the.
items.exam_angle: Hong Kong aur rashtriya suraksha kanoon: International exams ke liye — loktantra andolan aur videshi pratibandh aarop.

items.headline: South Korea: Hormuz ke paas mission badhega
items.detail: South Korea ne Cheonghae unit ka mission Gulf of Aden se Oman ke dakshin tak badhane ka faisla kiya; P-8A vimaan aur mine-clearing team bhi jodegi, sansad ki manzoori baaki hai.
items.exam_angle: Hormuz Strait aur samudri suraksha: International exams ke liye — tel marg aur antarrashtriya nauvahan.

items.headline: California: Arabpati tax haar ki taraf
items.detail: California me Proposition 40, jo lagbhag 200 arabpatiyon par ek baar 5% tax lagata, lagbhag 60% vote ginne par 55.6% 'No' ke saath haar ki taraf hai; natija abhi aadhikarik roop se ghoshit nahi hua.
items.exam_angle: America ki chunav vyavastha: International exams ke liye — ballot proposal aur wealth tax.

items.headline: Democrat ne Congress ke dono sadan jeete
items.detail: Democrat ne House me 235 seat jeetkar aur Senate me saat seat palatkar Congress ke dono sadan par kabza kar liya; Trump ko ab vibhajit sarkar me kaam karna hoga.
items.exam_angle: America ki chunav vyavastha: International exams ke liye — midterm chunav aur vibhajit sarkar.

items.headline: Bavaria neta Aiwanger Berlin hotel me mrit mile
items.detail: Bavaria ke up-pradhan aur arth mantri Hubert Aiwanger, 55, Berlin ke hotel kamre me mrit mile; police ne jaanch shuru ki, maut ka karan abhi saaf nahi hai.
items.exam_angle: Germany ki rajneeti: International exams ke liye — rajya sarkar aur neta.

items.headline: Myanmar Rohingya case: ICJ faisla 19 Nov ko
items.detail: ICJ ne kaha Gambia ke case me Myanmar ke khilaf antim faisla 19 November ko The Hague me sunaya jayega; Myanmar ne aaropon se inkaar kiya hai.
items.exam_angle: ICJ aur antarrashtriya kanoon: International exams ke liye — Rohingya case aur Genocide Convention.

items.headline: Komyshuvakha hamle me marne wale 40 hue
items.detail: Zelenskyy ne kaha sahayata kendra par hamle me 40 log mare gaye, 33 se badhkar, aur 30 se zyada abhi malbe ke neeche ho sakte hain.
items.exam_angle: Ukraine yuddh aur nagrik suraksha: International exams ke liye — sahayata kendra par hamla.

items.headline: Ukraine-Russia-America: Abu Dhabi me 10-11 Nov baatchit
items.detail: Zelenskyy ne Witkoff aur Kushner se 90 minute baat ki; team-level trilateral baatchit Abu Dhabi me 10-11 November ko hogi, suraksha guarantee aur hawai raksha par charcha hui.
items.exam_angle: Ukraine yuddh: shanti vaarta aur suraksha guarantee — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Japan: Shodo ko UNESCO virasat ki sifarish
items.detail: UNESCO ki salahkar sanstha ne Japan ki shodo kala ko Amurt Sanskritik Virasat suchi me shamil karne ki sifarish ki; antim faisla December me hoga.
items.exam_angle: UNESCO Amurt Sanskritik Virasat: International exams ke liye — Japan ki 24th entry ho sakti hai.
